value: passed from breeder birds into eggs
collapse and sudden death in young goslings

mortality.value: acute disease kills most affected goslings between 7 and 10 days old; adults show no symptoms

diagnosis.value: virus isolation along with immunofluorescence, electron microscopy and examination of tissue changes

value: vaccinating breeding geese before the laying season to pass protection to goslings through the egg

treatment_overview.value: no treatment exists for the virus itself; antibiotics may be used to help prevent secondary infections

summary.value: Derzsy's disease is a viral disease of geese caused by goose parvovirus, and it mainly kills young goslings within their first weeks of life. It is not described as a chicken disease, and prevention relies on vaccinating breeder geese and keeping good farm hygiene.
